title: PSI Cuts Ribbon On New Enclosures Facility
summary: PSI opened its new facility at 2401 State Line Road in Beloit April 22. The 100,000-square-foot facility builds custom-designed enclosures for power generation.
body_markdown:
Share


PSI officially opened its new facility at 2401 State Line Road in Beloit during a ribbon-cutting ceremony April 22. The 100,000-square-foot facility, which specializes in complete, custom-designed enclosures for PSI’s power generation product line, allows us to double our capacity.
